description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates the use of action bar tabs, including adding, removing, toggling tabs, and handling tab interactions via a TabListener. It includes inner classes for handling tab events and fragment content display.

classes.name: ActionBarTabs
classes.description: Android activity demonstrating action bar tabs with dynamic add, remove, toggle, and tab interaction handling.

classes.name: ActionBarTabs.TabListener
classes.description: Inner class implementing tab event callbacks, managing fragment transactions when tabs are selected, unselected, or reselected.

classes.name: ActionBarTabs.TabContentFragment
classes.description: Inner fragment class representing the content shown in each tab.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view.

methods.name: onAddTab
methods.description: Adds a new tab to the action bar with a dynamic label and sets its listener.

methods.name: onRemoveTab
methods.description: Removes the last tab if any exist.

methods.name: onToggleTabs
methods.description: Toggles the navigation mode between TABS and STANDARD, updating display options.

methods.name: onRemoveAllTabs
methods.description: Removes all tabs from the action bar.
